title: Clean FPS
description: A clean, performance-focused modpack that makes Minecraft run faster and smoother.
body:
# Clean FPS

A lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack built for **high FPS and a smooth vanilla experience**.

No unnecessary features—just smoother gameplay, faster chunk loading, and better frame stability.

This modpack is especially useful for **low-end PCs and laptops**, but it also helps higher-end systems run smoothly and consistently.

---

## Performance

All tests were performed using the same world seed, same position, settings, and render distance. Tests were done on the [Clean FPS Base Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps).  
FPS comparisons are available [here](https://youtu.be/O7Eqh2FlhU8)


### System - 26.1.2

- CPU: Ryzen 5 5500U
- GPU: Integrated Radeon Vega
- RAM: 16GB (dual channel)
- OS: Windows 11
- Resolution: 1080p (Fullscreen)
- Settings: Render Distance - 12, Simulation Distance - 5

**Results:**

| Metric   | Vanilla | Clean FPS |
|----------|--------|----------|
| Average  | 135.4    | 252.46      |
| Minimum  | 105    | 222      |
| Maximum  | 145    | 261      |

- Higher minimum FPS reduces stuttering during gameplay
- Higher average FPS improves overall smoothness


---

### Benefits

- Less stuttering while moving
- Faster world loading
- More stable FPS (fewer drops)

Performance improvements may vary depending on hardware and settings.

---

## Versions Available

This modpack comes in three variants:

- [**Clean FPS (Base)**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps) — `1.0.0`  
  Only optimization mods. No extra features. Focused on pure performance.

- [**Clean FPS + Zoom**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps-zoom) — `1.0.0-zoom`  
  Adds a simple zoom feature while preserving performance.

- [**Clean FPS + Zoom + Shaders**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps-shader) — `1.0.0-shader`  
  Includes shader support for improved visuals alongside optimization.

---

## Installation Guide

1. Install the Modrinth App or any launcher that supports Modrinth modpacks
2. Search for **Clean FPS** in the modpack browser
3. Select the version you want ([Base](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps) / [Zoom](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps-zoom) / [Shader](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cleanfps-shader))
4. Click Install
5. Launch the game and start playing

## Permissions

If you want to use **Clean FPS** as a base for your own modpack, feel free to do so.
Just make sure to include proper credit (a link back to this Modrinth page is enough).

---

## Notes

- Keeps the vanilla gameplay experience intact
- Works best on low-end systems, but benefits all hardware
- Shader version depends on your GPU capability
- Support for older Minecraft versions will be added gradually
- The modpack will continue to be updated for new Minecraft releases
